name: Human
description:
Humans are not the strongest, nor the quickest, nor the longest-lived. What they are is adaptable — constitutionally, stubbornly so. Where other peoples are often shaped by a deep affinity for one way of being, Humans are shaped by the capacity to adapt. It is a less dramatic gift than most, and rarer than it looks.

Height: 5-6' | Weight: 100-350 lbs | Average Lifespan: 80 years | Speed: 30
